_note: Query 4b (source 3b). Read-only s3api list-objects-v2 on acme-s3-access-logs (prefix bucket-logs-active/YYYY-MM-DD, 90 daily prefixes) then s3api get-object on each log object (about 3,800 objects; the GET cost is itemized at GATE 2). Log rows are SUMMARIZED by a throwaway filter; raw rows, requester IPs and keys are NOT recorded (Secrets rule). The verifying principal (CostPlanReadOnly) and AWS log-delivery requesters were excluded. Server access logs are best-effort and not guaranteed complete, so the counts are a lower bound.

daily_GET_distribution_90d.pattern: steady every day; no single burst
